name: Matthew Bremner
qualifications: BS Sci. (Politics, Law & Philosophy), LLB, LLM, (Environmental Law), Legal Education and Development
bio: Matthew holds a Bachelor of Social Science in Politics and Philosophy, an LLB, and a Master of Laws in Environmental Law, for which his thesis considered carbon tax and its effectiveness in promoting environmental conservation. He was admitted as an attorney of the High Court of South Africa in 2015.

He acts for individuals, businesses, construction companies, property developers and government institutions, and has appeared at levels from the Magistrates’ Court to the Constitutional Court, as well as regularly presenting matters to government committees.
Matthew’s work covers litigation, town planning law, environmental law, petroleum law, property law, administrative law and construction law.
